title: False-Positive Endpoint — Fabric Healthy, Host Silent (OS Upgrade)
symptom: Host 10.11.10.77 unreachable from all leaves. Et9 connected. Zero ingress counters. MAC aged out. No EVPN or underlay faults. Host confirmed down for OS upgrade.
root_cause: Ethernet9 on dc1-leaf1a (host access port) is shutdown, simulating a host that is physically connected but not sending traffic. Fabric is completely healthy.
